_about: Cables agent hand-back 2026-10-10, REVISED 2026-10-10 (imagery + DoT bathymetry run): what the page agent needs to add cables-reef-wa to the 3D tab (per 04_build/UPDATE_PROTOCOL.md). The first version (design drawing only) is in archive/pre_imagery_2026-10-10/PAGE_TEXTS_FOR_MAIN.json; 'old_to_new' lists the changes.
steps: (1) remove cables-reef-wa from 04_build/data/models3d_hold.json; (2) add entries to data/models3d_combined.json, models3d_curated.json, models3d_caveats.json; (3) run python src/update_page.py --full

combined.frame_note: model.js frame: x along the design-drawing axis toward SOUTH-SOUTH-EAST (bearing 170.3 deg T, M.frame.bearing_x_deg), y offshore toward WEST-SOUTH-WEST (bearing 260.3 deg T); the frame is rotated 9.7 deg from true north (georeferenced, DoT soundings); viewer maps (X = x, Y = z, Z = y); default version = Nov 1999 surveyed surface on the original-plan footprint (M.default_version = survey_surface_1999_11)
combined.crest_z: M.versions.filter(function(v){return v.id===M.default_version;})[0].crest_AHD_m (= -1.55 m, highest point of the surveyed surface, AHD taken as MSL); design crest RL -1.0 = -1.78 m MSL under reading A
combined.crest_note: surveyed (Nov 1999) highest surface point -1.55 m AHD (highest single sounding -1.40 m); design crest line RL -1.0 = -1.78 m MSL under datum reading A (RL = chart datum, MSL = RL + 0.78) or -1.0 m under reading B; the soundings imply an RL-AHD offset of 0.5-0.6 m (nearer to A)
combined.shore_mode: the seabed window starts at y = 190 m and the shore line (y = 0) is not modelled, so the 'seabed near 0 m MSL along y = 0' check cannot apply; use whatever mode skips it

curated.state_short: Default: rock surface surveyed by WA Department of Transport in Nov 1999 (840 soundings, month before completion) on the Lyons (1992) design footprint, georeferenced by those soundings, over the measured 1998 seabed. Also: Feb 2002 surveyed surface, design surface with and without the drawn south-arm extension (not confirmed), two plan-only outlines.
curated.ve_note: At VE = 5 the 2 m ramp looks 10 m high; slopes of 1:13 to 1:20 look like 1:2.6 to 1:4 (plan is true).
key_numbers: Footprint: {{versions/survey_surface_1999_11/area_m2|n0}} m2 (original design plan, 121 x 76 m; position and orientation fitted to the Nov 1999 soundings: 91 % of rock soundings inside; Lyons 1992 plan as reproduced in Blacka 2013 Fig A.2); text says 140 x 70 m (Blacka Table 4.2); drawn south-arm extension adds {{versions/design_plan_plus_extension_1999/area_m2|n0}} - {{versions/design_plan_original_1999/area_m2|n0}} = 306 m2 net of overlap (347 m2 drawn), NOT confirmed by the 2002 soundings or imagery

Rock volume: {{versions/survey_surface_1999_11/volume_m3|n0}} m3 surveyed (Nov 1999, +-1,000) and {{versions/survey_surface_2002_02/volume_m3|n0}} m3 (Feb 2002); design surface on the measured bed {{versions/design_plan_original_1999/volume_m3|n0}} m3 (original) / {{versions/design_plan_plus_extension_1999/volume_m3|n0}} m3 (with extension); stated 5,500 (Blacka 2013 A.1.3), 5,000 (Rendle; Mead and Borrero 2011), 3,500 (Wikipedia)

Crest: highest surveyed surface point {{versions/survey_surface_1999_11/crest_AHD_m|n2}} m AHD (Nov 1999), {{versions/survey_surface_2002_02/crest_AHD_m|n2}} m (Feb 2002); design crest RL -1.0 = 1.78 m below MSL (reading A) or 1.0 m (reading B); the soundings imply RL - AHD = 0.5-0.6 m (A = 0.78, B = 0); AHD taken as MSL (ASSUMPTION, +-0.1-0.3 m)

Water depth: measured bed (DoT 1998 soundings, AHD) 2.8-6.6 m below MSL along the outline vs stated 3.0-6.0 m (Blacka Table 4.2); 254-263 m from the reef centre to the 0 m AHD line (stated 250 / 275 m)

Tide: range 0.8 m (Blacka 2013 Table 4.3); mean tide level 0.78 m above datum (Pattiaratchi 1999 p.3), BoM Fremantle gauge MSL 0.773 m above gauge zero (1992-2011); HW/LW = MSL +-0.4 m is an estimate; HAT / LAT not found

caveat_rows: datum link RL / AHD / MSL: reading A nearer to the soundings, 0.2-0.3 m gap unresolved (Transport WA offset not found)
rock surface from single-beam soundings (+-0.3 m, about 5 m line spacing), interpolated between lines; no multibeam or lidar of the rock
south-arm extension drawn (347 m2, 320 m3) but not confirmed by the 2002 soundings (+0.43 m, n = 23) or by imagery
design-surface versions are idealised: volume 3,920 / 4,249 m3, below the surveyed 4,671 - 5,219 m3
no survey after Feb 2002; later settlement (Pitt 2009) not modelled
shore line not drawn (0 m AHD line 254-263 m east); frame rotated 9.7 deg from true north
